notes.title: Two new covers for the videogame in three different languages. New art available
notes.content:
Dear everyone, 

I made two covers for the three different languages available, you may choose the cover you most like and print it to have your physical copy. Fell free to request a cover in a different language, even if the game itself wont have it. 

The covers will be released on the next game update, You should find them on the installation folder of the videogame, inside the folder "BooksAndMaps". In that folder you should have;
[list]
[*] Two covers for the three different supported languages
[*] Map of west Eternalia
[*] Map of Northern City
[*] The book of the "Essence Reaper Ritual" in pdf. The original book telling the story of the party of adventurers. 
[*] Two Pdfs mapping gamepad controller and mouse/keyboard bindings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549828/3c890205878b988ea40541a9eeb2d1de8a7f85c4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549828/100b4a13fb8f9fdde3aea9b06fc21b0626a3fc59.png[/img]

Working now on the AI for your allies for the RPG campaign. I am trying to get the same AI for enemies to for allies, it is taking me longer to finish it that way, but later as we make AI more complex and enemies more challenging, it would be better as I wont need to do and track changes in both enemies and allies AI. 

Take care and be safe, 
The Herald!

notes.title: New RPG Campaign mode; Quest example, new inventory menu, map, etc.
notes.content:
Dear everyone, 

See how it is looking the new RPG game. 
https://youtu.be/9QhRpyKKyU8

Tons of new content;
[list]
[*] You will play with a party of up to 3 playable characters, you may switch control by just pressing TAB key on your keyboard, or if you use a gamepad, press left stick button. 
[*] Added a new inventory and map. This was tricky, as I am already programming the Xbox features so it works on Xbox as well. It doesnt have a cursor, thus I created a way of making it work for both platform. 
[*] More and more game control through joysticks and gamepads. Some bugs to be improved on the dialogue windows, currently working well for mouse cursor, I need to fine tune the gamepad controllers. 
[*] A new quest system which allows to track not only quests, but also your party member friendship, which will impact on the story later on. 
[*] Easter egg; I added a mirror somewhere in the game, so you can see how other people see Rose LeFay, as she is using a glamour to render her as a normal person. 
[*] Added a way of displaying tracks, so Fred the gnome thief can follow them. 
[/list]

notes.title: XMAS GIFT FOR D&U PLAYERS. NEW RPG CAMPAIGN TO BE ADDED SOON
notes.content:
Dear everyone, 

I am delighted to announce you I am adding a new mode to the videogame D&U, a full RPG campaign telling the story of Essence Reaper Ritual. 

[previewyoutube=sHLB5aQUqOM;full][/previewyoutube]

The reason is, when I did my first videogame, the Essence Reaper Ritual (ERR), I didnt have much experience at game development, and I did it on my own, the result is a game which works, but it has a complex code architecture. WIth all I learnt these past two years developing the ERR, I started developed a fun / casual game to play with family and friends, and that was the classic arcade mode you have on D&U, to play local or Steam Together. 

Realising I had created a very flexible platform and having all the assets (3D models, music, code, etc), I decided to add a Medieval First Person Shooter, local multiplayer (or Steam Play Together). 

And now, I decided to give you a full inmersion on the world of Eternalia by adding a RPG mode, with all the nice assets and experience I have been gaining through the years. 

To summarize, the final videogame should count with the following features;
[list]
[*] Classic Arcade fun/casual. Five levels. Each in a different environment and different enemies. 
[*] First Person Shooter Arena Mode. Five levels. As above. 
[*] RPG Campaign. Enough scenes to tell a slightly modified story from the ERR. 
[/list]

You should expect one major improvement per month. 
Once I finish the above, there is more stuff/ideas I could add, which I would like to share with you;
[list]
[*] Online multiplayer, through Steam servers. I already did some tests to pass info and basic character movements and actions among computers connected online, and it was working well. So, unless I encounter it doesnt work well together with enemies, AI, etc. I would say there is a great chance I release this mode in the future. I was considering the multiplayer to be a four cooperative game against 5 waves of enemies, just as the Arena Mode, and perhaps have the option to add a fifth player to be against the other players, effectively 1 versus 4. Although I would need to work a bit more on this to see if this is feasible with the programming architecture I developed. See picture below for the lobby design to get Steam players across the world to join;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549828/15b79a423b2162fcf196d1ac50a9e7b9430bbe5d.png[/img]

[*] D&U ORIGINS. Small modules or mini games telling the background story of some of the playable character, from childhood to what they become. I am playing with the idea of adding Samael´s story, the great necromancer villane to be among those stories. Starting playing with a nice White Elf and become the fearsome Great Necromancer!
[/list] 

As usual, please feel free to contact me to let me know bugs or your ideas / thoughts.

notes.title: AMAZING AND GORGEOUS NEW FPS SCENE. NEW SKILLS. MY HALLOWEEN GIFT FOR YOU!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween everyone, 

A game full of zombies, skeletons, vampires... I would say this game is in an everlasting Halloween mood!

My Halloween gift for you who choose to support this videogame, some new stuff;

[previewyoutube=Yq6dJulRZv0;full][/previewyoutube]

* New amazing FPS level; The Forest (some navigation issues to resolve with enemy AI...). 
* New skills. Each playable character has now two skills to use in combat, not tied to mana, just cooldowns. For example, Rose Lefay skill1 (Ilusionist) may create an ilusion of herself to attract enemy damage and even make it to attack enemies at high levels. Level 2 will summon a forest to entagle enemies, and at high levels, it may be accompanied by a spirit of the forest to fight along you. 
* Two New Achievements, only available during beta. Once game is released, these two releases may not be unlocked. 
* New epic music added to main menu and pre level. Check it out and let me know what you think!

I will be working on fixing some minor bugs related to complex terrain navigation and related to new skills. 

As usual, feel free to contact me with your ideas, thoughts, etc. 

Happy Trick or treating!

EDIT: My apologies, this new update brought a bug which I have just fixed. New characters loaded with cero health point. It happened when I integrated the new skills which modifies health points according to skills levels. It should be fixed now. Any issues, please let me know it.

Please let us know your thoughts.

notes.title: Added new inventory system and more buttons for different controllers
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

I programmed a new feature, an inventory system and added two items, so far; health potion and mana potion. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WibGhM1iA8w

This inventory system will allow you to;
[list]
[*] Collect different items just by touching them with your character
[/list] 
[list]
[*] Go through them without changing screen or anything, by pressing Dpad Right / Left of your gamecontroller (mouse wheel if you play with mouse/keyboard). When you change selected object, a short description telling what it is will be displayed for a short time. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Selected item is the one showing by your character potrait. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Drop item in front of you, so other players may collect them. Press Dpad Down (Button E when playing with Keyboard/Mouse)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Use item to gain regain health, mana, etc. Press Dpad Up (or button Q). 
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549828/d5abfba288ea2b1846d77c6a35ccb2103d3a3d3b.png[/img]

I am planning on adding new items, let me know what you think. For instance; Alchemist Fire so you could drop it aganst enemies and stay burning an area for few seconds, Ice Essence to freeze enemies, etc. Whatever effects do, I would be programming that they only harms enemies. I know it is not very realistic, but being a cooperative game, I dont want to see cases of dummy team players causing more harm than good. 

I made a gamepad mapping to help understanding controls;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37549828/509e7980016a268f26b2d554ebcbe57e6d7e434d.png[/img]


MORE PLANS;
I am considering adding extra special skills, one or two per player, which would have cooldown times based on time and not pulled by mana. Those skills would have different cooldown times depending on how poweful they are. For example, Fred the Gnome could set up traps, while Rose LeFay could create an ilusion of herself to distract enemies. Let me know what you think people. 

Thanks!

notes.title: Two new multiplayer modes; First Person and Arena Mode.
notes.content:
Guys!

Please see my WIP. I plan to add two more modes for the videogame;

* First Person Mode. Just do the normal Arcade campaign / levels in a first person mode, split screen. 

* Arena Mode. Get your party, venture forth, and face five waves of enemies. Waves will increase in difficulty, harder enemies, harder boss. 

Please feel free to comment and share it on your social media to give visibility to this project.
